reason_ko: 추가 직물·디지털 노이즈·수면 윤슬·조간대 노출은 공중 물보라의 아침 역광보다 주의를 분산하거나 다른 상황을 만든다. landscape 제안과 충돌 물보라 관계는 이미 독립 baseline에서 충분히 읽혀 추가 선택 계약을 채택할 필요가 없다. 기존 사람 중심 두 후보는 이번 pack에 없으며, 남은 선택적 실내·초현실 의미도 미채택한다.

semantic_clarification_decisions.rationale: The independent baseline retains all frozen requester anchors and required assertion phrases.
semantic_clarification_decisions.prompt_evidence: morning sunlight shining from behind the spray

semantic_clarification_decisions.rationale: A broken world invariant would add an impossible event to an ordinary natural-light scene at surreal level zero.
The adult-context gate is inactive, and an umbrella-folding person in a doorway is incompatible with the explicit no-people forest scene.
A winding path through depth could be an optional formal idea, but prescribing that path adds no needed clarity to the luminous spray and its visible origin.
An object-support demonstration would redirect attention from airborne water; the baseline already retains physically ordinary rock and water surroundings.
The meaning requires a visible wall lamp and an interior light pool, whereas the prescribed source is morning sunlight at a forest waterfall.
A drainage outlet above a wall and its localized runoff stain would add an artificial structural context unrelated to the natural waterfall.
Window-facing tabletop and deeper-room surfaces are indoor prerequisites absent from this forest scene.
The complete textile and underlying-body layering meaning adds a garment study to the environment subject and does not explain this water spray.

The collision-to-spray relation is compatible and already independently visible in the baseline. Its narrower coherent fan and wave-or-outlet realization would add optional geometry rather than improve the requested backlighting.

creative_decisions.rationale: Fabric weave and folds are absent from the forest-water subject, so a textile detail contract has no useful role in this photograph.
Landscape photography is compatible and already independently established. Keeping that genre adds no newly authored transformation and requires no candidate adoption.
Emphasizing shadow-local processing noise would compete with the transient lit droplets; clean irregular water detail is preferred for this natural-light study.
Wave-facet glitter is compatible with the pool but would promote reflected surface sparkles over the requested airborne spray; the existing luminous droplets remain the stronger focus.
Low-tide zones and a coastal exposure cycle supply a different natural event from the forest waterfall; action is also not an open refinement dimension.
